Definition
[Heat kernel with respect to an evolving metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0287 1. ch24:24.1\group Evolving Heat Kernels

A function $H(x,\tau ;y,v)$ on $\mathcal M\times \mathcal M\times \{ 0<\tau -v\le T\} $ is a fundamental solution for (L) if it has the standard space-time regularity, \[ L_{x,\tau }H=0,\qquad L^*_{y,v}H=0, \] and converges to $\delta _y$ as $\tau \searrow v$, equivalently to $\delta _x$ as $v\nearrow \tau $. The minimal positive fundamental solution is called the heat kernel.
